title: Linux container gate: Docker daemon unresponsive during session, rerun pending
what: The Docker daemon stopped responding during the 2026-11-03 session. The Linux container gate rerun is pending until Docker is healthy.
why: Docker images from this repo's own builds were being cleaned; the `backplane:linux` Docker image removal hung and was stopped. Restarting Docker Desktop would interrupt containers belonging to other projects.
impact: `make linux-gate` cannot be verified until Docker is healthy.
workaround: Restart Docker Desktop when it will not interrupt other projects' containers.
